diagnostics.message: required slot is declared but empty. An empty required slot is a hole wearing a value's clothes — a consumer cannot tell it from authored data.

declares the refusal floor "order.default.deny" but an empty (or absent) guard chain. With no guards, no EXECUTE / CONFIRM / ESCALATE / DEFER is reachable and REFUSE is the capability's only terminal — that is a dead capability, not a conservative one.
